_readme: Runtime overrides an installed copy picks up from the pack, no app update needed. Empty means 'use what was compiled in' — this file exists for the day something external moves: a retired tileset, a dead mirror. basemaps: per-style partial overrides keyed dark/light/streets, each {url?, labelsUrl?, attribution?, maxNativeZoom?, subdomains?}. rescues: a full replacement for the tile rescue ladder, each {url, attribution, maxNativeZoom, subdomains?} (labels are always baked into rescue tiles). eventsMirror: URL of an events.json fallback host, overriding the built-in one. accountHost: where the sign-in endpoints live, for a native shell — which has no server of its own to be relative to; null leaves signing in to the web app. packHost: where the pack itself is published, for a native copy that has no origin of its own to be relative to — overriding the one compiled in, so the pack can move house without an app release.
